title: Late BJP MLA Vungzagin Valte laid to rest in Manipur four months after death
description: Manipur CM attends Valte’s last rites, who was on ventilator support for almost three years and later died in February this year; Khemchand Singh regrets not being by Valte’s side during 2023 attack; says ‘Valte’s family is like my family and his friends and close ones are my friends too’
